slice: W206 checkpoint A: direct JSON actual metadata in Dynamic

claim.scope: Direct TAG_JSON descriptors in Dynamic V3 full/prefix/paired metadata, canonical roster/statistics and existing budgets; unbound value-ready consumers remain rejected, including unused arms.
claim.overall_goal: IN_PROGRESS: checkpoint B Object arm handoff, remaining types/layouts and MV/projections remain open; performance work is deferred.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST within the metadata and executed admission-guard corpus
claim.review_limitation: Luna candidates/reviews are correlated. Root reviewed the live production/spec diff and primary source, executed workloads serially, seeded guard removals, and independently audited raw native evidence.

implementation.root_cause: A common metadata gate rejected legal direct JSON actual descriptors. Representing their metadata does not supply an Object physical-stream binding; widening that gate required explicit value-ready guards.
implementation.architecture: Reuse descriptor/roster/budget owners and Object child-site APIs; no Cartesian-product serializer or second roster parser.
invariants: Only a direct JSON actual descriptor is newly representable; wrapped/composite JSON actuals remain rejected.
Dynamic value descriptor validation rejects unbound JSON before value lanes/routes/tags, including unused arms and zero windows.
Root ObjectDocumentPlan rejects unbound JSON actuals before plan map/copy allocations; metadata-only ObjectDynamicStructureSet does not confer value admission.
Existing typed Object, physical/bulk, SharedVariant and borrowed guards remain. Scalar RowBinary Dynamic(JSON) behavior is unchanged.
Existing internal display-name work preflight remains opt-in; no default standalone-decode bounded-name claim.
Malformed child occurrence grids can reject earlier than JSON descriptor validation, without inspecting value lanes.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: metadata widening could silently bypass storage admission.
boundaries.rollback: Revert only the scoped atomic local W206 commit; no source-part mutation, dependency/runtime change, remote push or history rewrite.
nonclaims: Persisted JSON actual values read/written through Dynamic, or a JSON Variant arm.
Independent qualification of the selected Object-arm stream roster/layout; W206 asserts the Dynamic metadata stream only.
SharedVariant inline JSON, Object-typed Dynamic, wrapped/composite JSON actuals or new physical layouts.
Library-written parts or ATTACH interoperability from this metadata-only stock witness.
Full types, MV/projections, repository-wide class decomposition, memory or speed parity.
